title: Symbia Energy — reading envelope
description:
Every value that reaches a screen is one of these. This is the existing Symbia provenance envelope with facility quality codes (OPC-UA / BACnet reliability shaped) so it reads natively to anyone who has done controls work.

Three invariants are enforced here rather than by convention:
  1. method estimated|asserted implies lane apocryphal. A forecast can never be re-canonicalised downstream.
  2. quality missing implies value null. NEVER zero. A dead meter reporting 0 kW makes PUE look excellent; that is the specific lie this product exists to prevent.
  3. trustworthy is derived, never asserted: exact AND inputs_verified AND quality good.

value.description: null when quality is missing. There is no sentinel value; a sentinel is a number that lies.

ts.description: When the value was TRUE in the field, not when it was received.

method.description: measured = a meter said so. computed = arithmetic over other readings, recomputable from expression+inputs. estimated = a model produced it (forecast, inference). asserted = a human or system claimed it with no computation behind it.

quality.description: good = fresh and trusted. stale = older than the point's max_age_s. uncertain = source flagged it (BACnet reliability fault, Sparkplug rebirth pending). missing = no value available. override = a human has forced it, which is honest but not measured.

expression.description: For computed readings: the literal expression, so the client can recompute and disagree. A computed number without an expression is an assertion wearing arithmetic's clothes.

trustworthy.description: DERIVED: exact AND inputs_verified AND quality == good. Never set directly.

uncomputable_reason.description: Set when a derive step declined to produce a value. Must name the specific missing or bad input, e.g. 'dc1.it.main.kw quality=missing since 20:31:07'. A refusal without a reason is just a gap.
